caption: The drawing depicts a dark green, metallic bird with its wings fully spread, perched on top of a spherical object that is itself bisected with lines and appears to rest on a vertical pole. The bird’s beak is open, and its head is slightly tilted downward. The wings are detailed with individual feathers, and there are several small holes or marks on both wings and body, suggesting wear or damage. The sphere under the bird has a leafy or feather pattern and is supported by a short, cylindrical rod. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. Near the lower right corner, the artist’s name "CHAS MAKRENOS" is written in small, capitalized text.
title: Eagle
